title: Suslin's Problem
exact_target: Do completeness, order density, lack of endpoints and countability of disjoint intervals characterize the ordered real line? This is the historical Suslin question; its answer is independent of ZFC, relative to the usual consistency assumption.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 1176 (SET-002). CC BY 4.0.
